notes.title: Update Notes for 24-08-19
notes.content:
* You can choose your chess level for a more tailored experience!
(Beginner (~600 Elo), Intermediate (~1200 Elo), Advanced (~1800 Elo), Expert (~2400 Elo))

* I’m always working to improve the translation! If you have any suggestions, please share them with the community!

* The game crash bug has been fixed! If you encounter any other issues, please report them!

notes.title: Update Notes for 24-08-18
notes.content:
You can enjoy the translated conversations with the Lady Bongcloud! 

We're currently working on fixing the bug where the game crashes when you checkmate her.

Additionally, we will allow you to choice her skill level.

notes.title: UI Language Patch
notes.content: I'm working on UI Language Supporting. soon You'd be able to play in your country's language!!
